                        </div>
                        <h3 class="news-title">
                            <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault()">Google DeepMind Introduces AlphaFold 3: A Leap Forward in Biomolecular Prediction</a>
                        </h3>
                        <p class="news-excerpt">
                            Google DeepMind has unveiled AlphaFold 3, a groundbreaking model capable of predicting the structure and interactions of all life's molecules with unprecedented accuracy. This advancement promises to accelerate drug discovery, materials science, and our understanding of biological processes. The model is now available via the AlphaFold Server for non-commercial research use.
                        </p>

                        </div>
                        <h3 class="news-title">
                            <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault()">EU AI Act Enters Into Force: What Businesses Need to Know</a>
                        </h3>
                        <p class="news-excerpt">
                            The European Union's landmark AI Act officially entered into force on June 13, 2025. The regulation establishes a risk-based framework for AI systems, with strict requirements for high-risk applications and outright bans on certain uses like social scoring. Companies have between 6 and 36 months to comply, depending on the risk category of their AI systems.
                        </p>
                        <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault()" class="read-more">Read more →</a>
                    </article>

                    <article class="news-item">
                        <div class="news-meta">

                            <span>Jun 13, 2025</span>
                        </div>
                        <h3 class="news-title">
                            <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault()">NVIDIA Announces Next-Generation Rubin AI Platform for 2026</a>
                        </h3>
                        <p class="news-excerpt">
                            NVIDIA has revealed its roadmap for the Rubin AI platform, slated for release in 2026. The platform will feature new GPUs, CPUs, and networking technologies designed to power the next wave of AI data centers. This announcement comes as NVIDIA continues to dominate the AI hardware market, with its stock reaching new all-time highs this week.
                        </p>
                        <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault()" class="read-more">Read more →</a>
                    </article>

                            <span>Jun 12, 2025</span>
                        </div>
                        <h3 class="news-title">
                            <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault()">Microsoft Launches Copilot+ PCs with Dedicated AI Hardware</a>
                        </h3>
                        <p class="news-excerpt">
                            Microsoft has introduced a new category of Windows PCs called Copilot+ PCs, featuring dedicated neural processing units (NPUs) capable of 40+ TOPS (trillions of operations per second). These devices are optimized for on-device AI tasks, including real-time translation, image generation, and advanced security features. Major OEMs like Dell, HP, and Lenovo are launching Copilot+ PCs starting this week.
                        </p>
                        <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault()" class="read-more">Read more →</a>
                    </article>

                        </div>
                        <h3 class="news-title">
                            <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault()">UN Report Highlights Growing AI Divide Between Nations</a>
                        </h3>
                        <p class="news-excerpt">
                            A new report from the United Nations warns of a growing "AI divide" between developed and developing nations. The report highlights disparities in access to AI technologies, digital infrastructure, and skilled workforces, which could exacerbate global inequality. The UN calls for international cooperation to ensure equitable access to AI benefits.
                        </p>
                        <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault()" class="read-more">Read more →</a>
                    </article>

                        <div class="news-meta">
                            <span class="category-tag">Open Source</span>
                            <span>Jun 10, 2025</span>
                        </div>
                        <h3 class="news-title">
                            <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault()">Meta Releases Llama 3.1: A 405B Parameter Open-Source Model</a>
                        </h3>
                        <p class="news-excerpt">
                            Meta has released Llama 3.1, its largest and most capable open-source large language model to date, with 405 billion parameters. The model is available for download and use under a permissive license, and Meta has also updated its smaller models (8B and 70B) with improved performance. This release is expected to accelerate open-source AI development and research.
                        </p>
